methods: Source logical trace unions select expected nets; native coordinates establish contacts.
All barrel layer representations are checked against foreign SMT pads, plated holes, vias, constant-width trace sweeps and native BREP pours.
Circle-versus-swept-trace and via-versus-via gaps are analytic; via annuli use 1024-edge circles for overlap confirmation.

Search radius 0.31 mm around outer barrel hull exceeds tested 0.20 mm clearance. Actual board policy is 0.15 mm via copper to foreign via copper, 0.30 mm drill to drill, and 0.20 mm via to pad/trace/pour. Numerical tolerance 1e-7 mm.
Below 0.20 mm preferred copper spacing is reported separately as refinement, not mislabeled as a declared-policy violation.
limitations: Other polygon models reuse independently audited native shape reader; imported pad geometric mapping is not rederived from datasheets.
Finished drill tolerances, mask, thermal ampacity and manufactured/bench behavior are not established.

directChecks.ratingReason: All measured barrel checks pass declared policy and no copper overlap exists. A 9+ rating is not justified because eleven foreign-net via pairs use 0.154–0.195 mm copper spacing, including a closest pair only 4.204 µm above the 0.15 mm declared minimum. This is a quantified refinement, not a short or a DRC failure.

strengths: Independent scan of 433 vias and 22 PTHs on all four layers found zero declared-policy violations and zero foreign copper overlaps.
431 ordinary 0.30 mm drill/0.70 mm annulus vias and two 0.20/0.50 mm vias preserve explicit full-barrel layer representation.
Closest via drill edge spacing 0.554204 mm exceeds the 0.30 mm board requirement; copper rings remain distinct.
166 GND vias and substantial VBUS/power via banks explain much of the total via count; count alone is not evidence of poor routing.

findings.explanation: Eleven unique foreign-net via pairs clear the board's 0.15 mm annular copper rule but have less than a preferred 0.20 mm gap. The closest TEC_CURRENT_COMMAND/GND pair is 0.154204308 mm apart at the copper edges, with 0 overlap and a 0.554204308 mm drill edge gap. Moving the nearby GND pickups while preserving ground continuity would create more routing margin. No reroute is required to remove a present short.

suspectedShortAssessment.classification: No confirmed via/PTH foreign-net contact in the exact Source23 artifact
suspectedShortAssessment.screenshotSpecificIdentification: Not independently located from the crop by this role; parent and screenshot-matching agents must identify the displayed trace nets/layers. This result rules out a barrel-related geometric short in the inspected exact capture, not an unidentified cloud-preview artifact.

topImprovements: Increase the eleven tight foreign via pairs to at least 0.20 mm where local ground pickup placement allows; prioritize pcb_via_148 versus pcb_via_401 and pcb_via_387.
Evaluate the 267 non-GND vias by route role before removing transitions; retain current-sharing power banks and avoid compromising the plane.
Make declared via-via copper minimum visible in review output so passing 0.15 mm contacts are not confused with the 0.20 mm via-pad requirement.
limitations: Static ideal CAD geometry only; no manufactured board or bench assessment.
Foreign barrel clearance uses a declared-policy scan and a separate preferred 0.20 mm refinement threshold.
Pad native shape modeling is reused from the existing independently audited geometry reader; this review does not revalidate supplier footprint dimensions.
Via barrel ampacity, parallel-current balance, thermal behavior, actual drill tolerance and signal stubs require their own engineering checks.
This role does not prove absence of a short in a cloud-rebuilt artifact whose bytes differ from the inspected SHA.
